definitions.explanation: A short burst of running at full speed, or a rush to get somewhere. As ダッシュする it means to dash or sprint; in sports it is a short sprint, and casually any quick hurry (to the station, to the shop).
The long horizontal line used in writing, in Japanese as in English, to mark a break, an aside, or a range.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ダッシュ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
スタートダッシュ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧だ。
examples.english: A good start (a fast first burst) is what matters.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ダッシュ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sprint at full speed
- スタートダッシュ: a fast start (literal or figurative)
- ダッシュ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to hurry home
- ダッシュ⟦{記号|きごう}→記号：00224_kigou⟧: the dash sign

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}→全力疾走：22558_zenryokushissou⟧: running flat out — describes the speed, more written
- ⟦{奪取|だっしゅ}→奪取：12214_dasshu⟧: seizure, capture — a different word with the same reading
